name: Pink Elephants Trinity
review:
Pink Elephants Trinity is a 4x6 jungle slot starting at 4,096 ways and growing to 16,384. A scatter mystery feature and sticky wilds lead into a six-level bonus where you collect sacred peanuts.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 14,400x cap, and lists the RTP as "up to 96%".
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
